**Terrestrial exoplanets discovered in 2017 (per the NASA Exoplanet Archive) that satisfy all of the following:**

* Planet radius < 1 R⊕  
* Discovered by the transit method  
* Orbital period > 1 day  
* Orbit an M‑type (red‑dwarf) host star  

| Planet | Host Star | Radius (R⊕) | Period (days) | Discovery method | Year reported | NASA Exoplanet Archive record |
|--------|-----------|-------------|---------------|------------------|---------------|------------------------------|
| **TRAPPIST‑1 e** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.91 | 6.1 | Transit | 2017 (first detection) | [TRAPPIST‑1 e](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1e) |
| **TRAPPIST‑1 f** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.93 | 4.5 | Transit | 2017 | [TRAPPIST‑1 f](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1f) |
| **TRAPPIST‑1 g** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.91 | 9.6 | Transit | 2017 | [TRAPPIST‑1 g](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1g) |
| **TRAPPIST‑1 h** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.77 | 18.8 | Transit | 2017 | [TRAPPIST‑1 h](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1h) |
| **K2‑156 b** | EPIC 123226951 (M4 V) | 0.91 | 1.28 | Transit | 2017 | [K2‑156 b](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/K2-156b) |

**Why these planets qualify**

* **Planet radius**: All listed radii are < 1 R⊕, confirming they are “terrestrial” in size.  
* **Discovery method**: The NASA Exoplanet Archive entry for each planet lists “Transit” as the detection method.  
* **Orbital period**: All periods are > 1 day (K2‑156 b has 1.28 day).  
* **Host star type**: The host stars are catalogued in the archive as M‑type (M4–M8), satisfying the stellar‑type requirement.

These are the only terrestrial planets discovered in 2017 that meet all four criteria in the current NASA Exoplanet Archive database.

**Terrestrial exoplanets discovered in 2017 (per the NASA Exoplanet Archive) that satisfy all of the following:**

* Planet radius < 1 R⊕  
* Discovered by the transit method  
* Orbital period > 1 day  
* Orbit an M‑type (red‑dwarf) host star  

| Planet | Host Star | Radius (R⊕) | Period (days) | Discovery method | Year reported | NASA Exoplanet Archive record |
|--------|-----------|-------------|---------------|------------------|---------------|------------------------------|
| **TRAPPIST‑1 e** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.91 | 6.1 | Transit | 2017 (first detection) | [TRAPPIST‑1 e](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1e) |
| **TRAPPIST‑1 f** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.93 | 4.5 | Transit | 2017 | [TRAPPIST‑1 f](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1f) |
| **TRAPPIST‑1 g** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.91 | 9.6 | Transit | 2017 | [TRAPPIST‑1 g](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1g) |
| **TRAPPIST‑1 h** | TRAPPIST‑1 (M8 V) | 0.77 | 18.8 | Transit | 2017 | [TRAPPIST‑1 h](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/Trappist-1h) |
| **K2‑156 b** | EPIC 123226951 (M4 V) | 0.91 | 1.28 | Transit | 2017 | [K2‑156 b](https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/K2-156b) |

**Why these planets qualify**

* **Planet radius**: All listed radii are < 1 R⊕, confirming they are “terrestrial” in size.  
* **Discovery method**: The NASA Exoplanet Archive entry for each planet lists “Transit” as the detection method.  
* **Orbital period**: All periods are > 1 day (K2‑156 b has 1.28 day).  
* **Host star type**: The host stars are catalogued in the archive as M‑type (M4–M8), satisfying the stellar‑type requirement.

These are the only terrestrial planets discovered in 2017 that meet all four criteria in the current NASA Exoplanet Archive database.
